plan14 Day 4 (#1 Agent-to-Agent Delegation) — delegate a specific, well-scoped sub-task to another agent by capability, resolved via FleetManager.select(). Real invocation, gated by app.agents.delegation's depth limit, cycle detection, config-driven allowed-capability policy, shared budget, and a wall-clock timeout.
manifest.notes: high risk deliberately: can trigger real, costly agent work. Marking it high-risk here reinforces plan14 Day 1's dynamic-tool-selection contract-drift check — any agent whose runtime tool list includes this tool but whose own AgentCapability.tools doesn't declare it gets it filtered out automatically.
